attacker_pocs.name: invalid_format_read
attacker_pocs.why: The public Unicode deserializer checks the format through a helper that indexes the result of hb_buffer_serialize_format_to_string. That function returns NULL for the public INVALID format, so the check reads through NULL before it can return false. The upstream fix dispatches on the format enum and returns false without dereferencing a format name.

role_a_rationale: This commit validates the format before setting content_type, preserving the behavior of supported formats and leaving empty buffers unchanged for unsupported formats in the intended control flow. Unlike the upstream switch-based fix, it reuses the public format-to-string mapping but dereferences its nullable return value. The shared helper is the single new memory-safety defect; the sanitizer reports a null read on the shipped build, while the same public-API PoC exits successfully on the golden build. The focused buffer serialization API test and valid Unicode and glyph text deserialization pass. The full Meson suite could not run because Meson is not installed in this environment.
